name: 76448 · Eastland, TX
findings: ZIP 76448 (Eastland) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (67% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 76448 (Eastland) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
